$comment: Requires CMake 4.2+. Schema v10 (3.31/4.x). Upgrade $schema hash from cmake.org/cmake/help/v4.2 when IDE validation matters.

configurePresets.$comment: Base preset — inherit in all others. Override apk_input to skip auto-download.
configurePresets.name: default

apk_input.$comment: Leave empty to auto-download original.apk from GitHub release

buildPresets.name: decompile
buildPresets.description: apktool d + decrypt JSON + apply patches/money/

buildPresets.name: sync
buildPresets.description: Rebuild orig/ baseline, regenerate patches/ from the working tree

buildPresets.name: build
buildPresets.description: Stage, encrypt, apktool b, sign — produces wc4_ru and wc4_ru_mod

buildPresets.name: deploy-waydroid
buildPresets.description: Install both signed APKs via waydroid

buildPresets.name: deploy-android
buildPresets.description: Install both signed APKs via adb install -r

workflowPresets.$comment: Full pipeline: configure once, then build (implies sync) + deploy
workflowPresets.name: release
